business_problem: ezCater needed to handle increasingly complex workplace food orders, last-minute changes, and hybrid-work demand swings without forcing customers or service staff through manual, error-prone update workflows.
solution_summary: ezCater is using Agentforce with Data Cloud, Service Cloud, Sales Cloud, and Slack to turn group-food ordering into a conversational, data-driven workflow that can adapt to modern workplace complexity. Instead of requiring customers to navigate forms for every dietary change, venue update, or reorder, Agentforce accepts natural-language requests and translates them into structured actions that update the order and, when needed, escalate the work to a human representative with the right context. Data Cloud centralizes millions of workplace food-order records so the agent can recommend restaurants, compose combinations that fit headcount and dietary constraints, and improve forecasting for future demand surges. The same architecture extends into Slack, where ezCater plans to let workplace teams poll preferences, adjust orders, and share feedback from inside a public app, keeping customer interaction, data, and follow-up on one connected platform.
data_flow: Customer requests are captured in natural language, Agentforce uses Data Cloud order history to recommend menus or apply changes, structured order details are passed into ezCater systems or escalated through Service Cloud, and Slack extends the workflow to workplace teams for collaboration and feedback.
business_outcome: ezCater expects smoother ordering for customers, fewer errors during complex modifications, better demand forecasting, and more time for reps to focus on truly exceptional or sensitive issues.
metrics: Nearly two decades of catering data
architecture_clues: Agentforce converts conversational requests into structured order inputs for ezCater systems.
Data Cloud is intended to centralize order history and support predictive demand modeling.
Slack is a customer-facing extension point for ordering and preference polling.
evidence_quotes: Agentforce will automatically adjust the orders, making the process as intuitive as speaking to a human.
By leveraging data from millions of workplace food orders, Agentforce will enable the virtual agent to provide tailored suggestions.
ezCater plans to launch a public app in the Slack App Marketplace.
Using predictive models on Salesforce Data Cloud, ezCater will anticipate and prepare for new orders.
